final_rationale: The verdict does not change. No new admissible evidence was introduced; the Actor reframed the same record more narrowly. On this record, operational launch readiness is supported, but policy compliance for certification remains unresolved rather than affirmatively established. That keeps the claim in suspicious rather than moving it toward compliance.
